functions.name: addApi
functions.description: Adds an API that routes requests to an Aspire compute resource.
functions.remarks:
The generated API contains catch-all operations for supported HTTP methods and paths. The generated policy routes
requests through an API Management backend entity whose URL is resolved from the target deployment environment.
functions.returns: A builder for the API resource.

parameters.description: The globally unique Aspire resource name and default physical API name.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The backend compute resource. It must expose an HTTP or HTTPS endpoint. Internal endpoints require the API Management service to have virtual network connectivity to the target.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The public path beneath the API Management gateway hostname.

parameters.name: displayName
parameters.description: The API display name. The resource name is used when omitted.

parameters.name: subscriptionRequired
parameters.description: Whether callers must provide an API Management subscription key. The default is `true`.

parameters.name: apiName
parameters.description: The physical API identifier in API Management. The Aspire resource name is used when omitted.

functions.name: withAzureUserAssignedIdentity
functions.description: Configures the user-assigned managed identity used by API Management.
functions.remarks:
New services attach the supplied identity automatically instead of creating a default identity.
For an existing service, the supplied identity must be configured as an existing resource and
already attached to the service outside Aspire. Aspire does not change or verify the existing
service's identity attachments. Backend and Key Vault permissions use the supplied identity.
functions.returns: The Azure API Management resource builder.

parameters.name: identityResourceBuilder
parameters.description: The user-assigned managed identity.

functions.name: withClassicVirtualNetwork
functions.description: Injects a classic Developer or Premium API Management service into a virtual network subnet.
functions.remarks:
This API models classic VNet injection only. Standard v2 outbound integration and Premium v2 injection have
different subnet delegations and lifecycle constraints. Use `WithVirtualNetworkIntegration` for
Standard v2 outbound integration or `WithVirtualNetworkInjection` for Premium v2 injection.
See APIM virtual networking.

parameters.name: subnet
parameters.description: The subnet resource. Classic APIM injection requires an undelegated subnet with an NSG.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Whether the APIM endpoints are externally or internally accessible.

functions.name: withOpenApiDocument
functions.description: Imports an OpenAPI document from a file into an API.
functions.remarks:
The document is read when generating infrastructure for publish or deploy, never during run mode.
It must exist and contain non-whitespace content by the time infrastructure is generated.
An API can have only one OpenAPI source: either a document file or an endpoint.
Repeating the same source configuration is allowed; configuring a different source throws.
functions.returns: The API Management API resource builder.

parameters.name: documentPath
parameters.description: The document path, relative to the AppHost directory when not absolute.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The document format. The file extension is used when omitted.

functions.name: withOpenApiEndpoint
functions.description: Imports an OpenAPI document exposed by the API's target compute resource.
functions.remarks:
Azure API Management retrieves linked documents through its control plane, so the selected endpoint must be
externally reachable during deployment. Use `WithOpenApiDocument` for private backends.
An API can have only one OpenAPI source: either a document file or an endpoint.
Repeating the same source configuration is allowed; configuring a different source throws.
functions.returns: The API Management API resource builder.
functions.signature: withOpenApiEndpoint(documentPath?: string, endpointName?: string, format?: AzureApiManagementOpenApiFormat): AzureApiManagementApiResource

parameters.name: documentPath
parameters.description: The absolute path of the OpenAPI endpoint, such as `/openapi/v1.json`.

parameters.name: endpointName
parameters.description: The target endpoint name. An external HTTP or HTTPS endpoint is selected when omitted.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The document format. The endpoint path extension is used when omitted.

functions.name: withPolicy
functions.description: Replaces the complete service-level policy document.
functions.remarks:
APIM policy updates replace the complete policy document at a scope. To prevent silently dropping policy fragments,
this method cannot be combined with `WithInboundPolicy`
at the same scope.

parameters.name: policyXml
parameters.description: A complete APIM `policies` XML document.

functions.name: withPolicy
functions.description: Replaces the complete API-level policy document.
functions.remarks:
Replacing the API policy also replaces the generated backend-routing policy. The supplied document must
configure backend routing when the API should continue forwarding requests.

parameters.name: policyXml
parameters.description: A complete APIM `policies` XML document.

functions.name: withPolicy
functions.description: Replaces the complete operation-level policy document.

parameters.name: policyXml
parameters.description: A complete APIM `policies` XML document.

functions.name: withVirtualNetworkInjection
functions.description: Injects a Premium v2 API Management service into a virtual network for private inbound and outbound access.
functions.remarks:
The subnet is delegated to `Microsoft.Web/hostingEnvironments`. Premium v2 injection can only be
selected when the service is created and cannot later be changed to virtual network integration.
See Premium v2 virtual network injection.

parameters.name: subnet
parameters.description: A dedicated subnet for API Management virtual network injection.

functions.name: withVirtualNetworkIntegration
functions.description: Integrates a Standard v2 or Premium v2 API Management service with a virtual network for outbound access.
functions.remarks:
The subnet is delegated to `Microsoft.Web/serverFarms`. The APIM gateway remains publicly accessible,
while backend traffic can reach resources in the virtual network.
See APIM outbound virtual network integration.

parameters.name: subnet
parameters.description: A dedicated subnet for API Management virtual network integration.

parameters.name: options

parameters.name: options

capabilities.name: withAzureUserAssignedIdentity
capabilities.description: Configures the user-assigned managed identity used by API Management.
capabilities.remarks:
New services attach the supplied identity automatically instead of creating a default identity.
For an existing service, the supplied identity must be configured as an existing resource and
already attached to the service outside Aspire. Aspire does not change or verify the existing
service's identity attachments. Backend and Key Vault permissions use the supplied identity.
capabilities.returns: The Azure API Management resource builder.

parameters.name: identityResourceBuilder
parameters.description: The user-assigned managed identity.

capabilities.name: withClassicVirtualNetwork
capabilities.description: Injects a classic Developer or Premium API Management service into a virtual network subnet.
capabilities.remarks:
This API models classic VNet injection only. Standard v2 outbound integration and Premium v2 injection have
different subnet delegations and lifecycle constraints. Use `WithVirtualNetworkIntegration` for
Standard v2 outbound integration or `WithVirtualNetworkInjection` for Premium v2 injection.
See APIM virtual networking.

parameters.name: subnet
parameters.description: The subnet resource. Classic APIM injection requires an undelegated subnet with an NSG.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Whether the APIM endpoints are externally or internally accessible.

capabilities.name: withCustomDomain
capabilities.description: Configures a custom hostname from a polyglot AppHost using a certificate stored in Azure Key Vault.
capabilities.signature: withCustomDomain(hostname: string, vault: AzureKeyVaultResource, certificateSecretName: string, type?: AzureApiManagementHostnameType, defaultSslBinding?: boolean, negotiateClientCertificate?: boolean): AzureApiManagementResource

capabilities.name: withInboundPolicy
capabilities.description: Appends an XML policy statement to the service-level inbound policy section.

parameters.name: policyXml
parameters.description: One or more well-formed APIM policy elements without a `policies` envelope.

capabilities.name: withInboundPolicyFragment
capabilities.description: Includes a policy fragment in the service-level inbound policy.

parameters.name: fragment
parameters.description: The policy fragment to include.

capabilities.name: withPolicy
capabilities.description: Replaces the complete service-level policy document.
capabilities.remarks:
APIM policy updates replace the complete policy document at a scope. To prevent silently dropping policy fragments,
this method cannot be combined with `WithInboundPolicy`
at the same scope.

parameters.name: policyXml
parameters.description: A complete APIM `policies` XML document.

capabilities.name: withVirtualNetworkInjection
capabilities.description: Injects a Premium v2 API Management service into a virtual network for private inbound and outbound access.
capabilities.remarks:
The subnet is delegated to `Microsoft.Web/hostingEnvironments`. Premium v2 injection can only be
selected when the service is created and cannot later be changed to virtual network integration.
See Premium v2 virtual network injection.

parameters.name: subnet
parameters.description: A dedicated subnet for API Management virtual network injection.

capabilities.name: withVirtualNetworkIntegration
capabilities.description: Integrates a Standard v2 or Premium v2 API Management service with a virtual network for outbound access.
capabilities.remarks:
The subnet is delegated to `Microsoft.Web/serverFarms`. The APIM gateway remains publicly accessible,
while backend traffic can reach resources in the virtual network.
See APIM outbound virtual network integration.

parameters.name: subnet
parameters.description: A dedicated subnet for API Management virtual network integration.
